wu_2015_abalone_gonad.title: Purification and characterization of a novel angiotensin I-converting enzyme inhibitory peptide derived from abalone (Haliotis discus hannai Ino) gonads (Wu Q, Cai QF, Tao ZP, Sun LC, Shen JD, Zhang LJ, Liu GM, Cao MJ)
wu_2015_abalone_gonad.terms: Bibliographic record and numeric values only; no text or tables copied

peptide_bioactivity.verification: Full text (library PDF): gonads of live Pacific abalone Haliotis discus hannai Ino (80-90 g, local market, Xiamen; WoRMS accepted subspecies of H. discus 397082) hydrolysed with alcalase then papain; the active peptide was purified by gel filtration and RP-HPLC and sequenced by automated Edman degradation (PPSQ-33A) as Ala-Met-Asn. A peptide of the same sequence was synthesized and assayed with 6.5 mM HHL in borate buffer pH 8.3 with 0.3 M NaCl, 37 °C for 60 min (Methods); the abstract and Results give IC50 106.24 ug/mL. The paper gives no uM value, so 3.14 and earlier did not score it (evidence-mackerel-2026-10-01.md section 2). The unit-conversion rule converts it with the free-peptide mass of AMN.
